79305.subject: The SEC Cleared Stocks To Trade Onchain in the U.S.
79305.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[The SEC](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-innovation-exemption-tokenized-stocks-cftc-software-relief)**[ cleared tokenized stocks to trade onchain as the CFTC widened software relief](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-innovation-exemption-tokenized-stocks-cftc-software-relief)

* **[X](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/x-adds-us-trade-button-to-cashtags-with-coinbase-kraken-and-gemini)**[ put a U.S. "Trade" button on cashtags with Coinbase, Kraken and Gemini](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/x-adds-us-trade-button-to-cashtags-with-coinbase-kraken-and-gemini)

* **[S&P Global](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/s-p-global-to-acquire-openzeppelin-in-onchain-risk-push)**[ agreed to buy OpenZeppelin and move into onchain code risk](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/s-p-global-to-acquire-openzeppelin-in-onchain-risk-push)

* **[Polymarket](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/polymarket-hires-ex-zora-ceo-for-onchain-product-push)**[ hired ex-Zora CEO Jacob Horne as it rewrites its order book in Rust](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/polymarket-hires-ex-zora-ceo-for-onchain-product-push)

* **[Blockworks](https://thedefiant.io/news/infrastructure/blockworks-agentic-detection-ai-agents-compliance-alerts-exchanges)**[ will let exchanges take compliance alerts straight from AI agents](https://thedefiant.io/news/infrastructure/blockworks-agentic-detection-ai-agents-compliance-alerts-exchanges)

Two days after the Senate refused to take up the CLARITY Act, the SEC issued a five-year conditional exemption on Thursday letting tokenized National Market System stock trade onchain through permissioned liquidity pools. CFTC staff opened introducing-broker relief to passive software providers the same morning. Uniswap's token rose 19.8% over 24 hours.

The order creates a category the Commission calls a Tokenized Securities Venue and exempts it from the exchange definition in Section 3(a)(1) of the Exchange Act. A venue may list 75 Tier 1 symbols and trade up to 0.25% of each one's prior-month average daily volume; Tier 2 runs to 250 symbols at 2.5%. Breach a cap and that security pauses for three months. Venues halt when the primary listing exchange halts, publish 30 days of transaction data updated within 10 minutes, and give issuers 30 calendar days' notice before listing a third-party tokenization — [a written objection filed by day 30 bars the listing outright](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-innovation-exemption-tokenized-stocks-cftc-software-relief).

Paul Atkins called the order an interim measure that "must be followed by durable rulemaking." Hester Peirce drew the line the industry will argue over for the next five years: the order "is not about decentralized finance," and permissionless smart contracts need no exemption at all.
